name: overflow-actions
title: Overflow actions
description: A row of actions that moves whatever does not fit into a More menu, by priority, measured on resize, so a toolbar works at every width.
docs: Give it the width of its container (it is a block, w-full). pinned actions never move; a lower priority leaves first. Use separatorBefore to keep groups in the menu, and onOverflowChange to learn which ids moved.
